intro: Sri Lanka is a teardrop-shaped island off southern India, with beaches, rainforests and cool tea-covered hills.

chapters.title: Hills and coast
text: Mountains rise in the south-centre; Pidurutalagala is the highest at 2,524 m. Adam's Peak is a sacred mountain climbed by pilgrims at night. The north is flat and dry.
Palk Strait separates the island from India by about 30 km.

chapters.title: Wildlife
text: Sri Lanka has leopards, elephants and blue whales offshore, and Yala National Park has one of the highest densities of leopards in the world.
